bench_setup = function() {
  set.seed(20261117)
  n = 200L
  w = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
  x1 = rnorm(n); x2 = rnorm(n)
  pi0 = stats::plogis(-0.5 + 0.3 * x1)
  mu = exp(0.8 + 0.4 * w + 0.3 * x1 - 0.2 * x2)
  y = ifelse(runif(n) < pi0, 0, rpois(n, mu))
  dat = data.frame(y = y, w = w, x1 = x1, x2 = x2)
  list(dat = dat, weights = rexp(n))   # one Bayesian-bootstrap draw of row weights
}
